project.name: CollegePath AI
project.purpose: Master FAQ retrieval corpus for a college-admissions chatbot using TF-IDF and cosine similarity.

retrieval_method.threshold_note: 0.30 is an initial engineering value, not a probability of correctness. Tune it using a labeled validation set.

project.fallback_policy: Never force a low-similarity answer. Ask a clarifying question or route the user to an official source.
project.dynamic_information_policy: Deadlines, acceptance rates, current costs, testing policies, scholarships and college-specific aid require current verification.

source_hierarchy.purpose: Final authority for current college-specific requirements, policies, deadlines and awards.
Common App, College Board and EducationUSA guidance.
